people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
translations.bsb: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
translations.kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood
translations.asv: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, Where I heard a language that I knew not.
